content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 13.4 was a one-sided M&I cap at three months' payments with no carve-outs — two walk-away triggers (Customer uncapped while Vendor capped; Vendor cap below six months' fees), with the Section 14.2 indemnities trapped inside the cap. I made the single capping sentence mutual, moved the basis to twelve months' payments, and carved out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct, meeting every fallback element in one surgical edit while leaving the Section 13.2 mutual consequential-damages waiver, the one-year suit limitation and the collection proviso untouched.
